Record Class DiceNode.Reroll

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
be.imgn.gaia.core.random.dice.DiceNode.Reroll
Record Components:
times - whether dice are rerolled, and how many times
target - on which faces dice are rerolled
relation - how the face of a die is compared to value
value - the right operand of the comparison
Enclosing interface:
DiceNode<T>
public static record DiceNode.Reroll(DiceNode.Reroll.Times times, DiceNode.Reroll.Target target, DiceNode.Relation relation, int value) extends Record
Which dice are rolled again: NONE, those that show their lowest face, or those whose face satisfies a condition, either once or until the face no longer does.
Since:
0.2.0

  • Constructor Details

    • Reroll

      public Reroll(DiceNode.Reroll.Times times, DiceNode.Reroll.Target target, DiceNode.Relation relation, int value)
      Creates a rule.
      Parameters:
      times - whether dice are rerolled, and how many times
      target - on which faces dice are rerolled
      relation - how the face of a die is compared to value
      value - the right operand of the comparison
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if target isn't DiceNode.Reroll.Target.MATCHING and the condition isn't that of NONE, or if times is DiceNode.Reroll.Times.NEVER and the rule isn't NONE
